unsupported: Dufrane Technologies was founded in 1876 in Winsted, Connecticut, and remains a family-owned business operating as part of the Dufrane family of companies.
The company began as a manufacturer of custom electromagnetic components and has expanded over more than a century to include precision machining services.
Its client base includes defense contractors and original equipment manufacturers seeking contract manufacturing for both electromagnetic and purely mechanical parts.
It was built to provide a single source for custom coil winding, transformer design, and precision machining, reducing lead times and ensuring quality control across the entire production process.

Known for: In-house CNC machining with 5-axis and large-envelope centers; Custom transformer and coil winding design and manufacturing; Reverse engineering and design-build services; 80,000+ sq ft facility with combined 150+ years experience; Family-owned, part of Dufrane family of companies
